message.content:
In a standard deck of cards there are only **13 hearts**.  
In a typical poker game the number of hearts a single player can hold depends on how many cards are dealt to them:

| Game | Cards dealt to each player | Maximum hearts a player can hold |
|------|----------------------------|----------------------------------|
| Texas Hold’em | 2 hole cards + 5 community cards (7 total) | **7 hearts** |
| Five‑card draw | 5 cards | **5 hearts** |
| Seven‑card stud | 7 cards | **7 hearts** |

So the “highest number of hearts” a player can have in a hand is simply the maximum hearts that can fit into the hand size.  
The player who actually has that many hearts is the one whose hand contains the most hearts.  

If you want to see this in action for a particular game, let me know the number of players and cards per player and I can simulate a deal for you.
